dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Invitation to the optional pond battle.

lines.speaker: Ida
lines.text: I mend nets for the dock crews. This is where I rest my hands. Shall we let our companions stretch instead?

description: Ida mends nets for the dock crews and visits the pond to rest her hands. She offers an optional battle as a chance for the companions to stretch instead. She can see marks on the island stone but cannot read them from shore and refuses to swim across. Skilled work and a sensible limit distinguish her from a keeper of hidden obelisk lore.

sections: §32: pond, fishermen, relocated Psyduck and unresolved obelisk.

data.description: Mends nets for the dock crews; rests her hands at the pond.
